data.text: Anomalies (T1) show that three sites in SAH (S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008) suffered an RRC success rate drop and drop rate spike starting on 2026-09-10 at 10:15 and lasting until 2026-09-11 06:00. Competing hypotheses include a transport failure/degradation on the shared fiber link or aggregation router, or a configuration/software change affecting that transport path. Next, I will check alarms, changes, and maintenance on these three sites and their shared transport parent (`LNK-SAH-01-A` and `AGG-SAH-01`) during the incident window.

[turn 4] The evidence (T6) reveals parameter tuning changes CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, and CHG-2026-0028 applied precisely at 10:23 on 2026-09-10 to the three affected sites (S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008), matching the 10:15 KPI degradation onset. Transport links and routers showed no changes or alarms during that window (T8, T9), ruling out transport failure. These configuration changes were subsequently rolled back on 2026-09-11 (CHG-2026-0031, CHG-2026-0032, CHG-2026-0033), coinciding with the clearance of anomaly ALR-0010. The leading explanation—a bad configuration change (parameter optimisation batch OPT-21)—is fully confirmed by timing, scope, and recovery.

The RRC success rate fell across S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 yesterday morning due to a bad configuration change. Specifically, parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to these three sites via change tickets CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, and CHG-2026-0028 on 2026-09-10 at 10:23, directly coinciding with the onset of the degradation. Transport infrastructure, core nodes, and maintenance schedules were unaffected. The issue was resolved when the changes were rolled back on 2026-09-11.

data.markdown:
# RRC Success Rate Drop in Sahel Sites

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SAH-002`
- **Confidence:** medium (Timing fits KPI onset perfectly, but external events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 10:15 to 2026-09-11 06:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 10:23
- **Affected:** S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to the affected sites, causing RRC success rate degradation and drop rate spikes.

RRC success rate fell and drop rate spiked across three Sahel sites.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 09:22: Warning TEMP_HIGH raised on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000193]
- 2026-09-10 09:46: Warning TEMP_HIGH cleared on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000193]
- 2026-09-10 10:15: RRC success drops and drop rate spikes begin on 3 sites. [ALR-0010, T1]
- 2026-09-10 10:23: Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 applied to S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008. [CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028]
- 2026-09-11 06:00: Alert ALR-0010 cleared following rollbacks. [ALR-0010, T1]

## Evidence

- RRC success drops and drop rate spikes occurred on three sites in Sahel starting 2026-09-10 10:15. [ALR-0010]
- Parameter tuning changes were applied to S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 at 2026-09-10 10:23. [CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028]
- No transport changes occurred on LNK-SAH-01-A or AGG-SAH-01 between 09:00 and 11:00. [T8]
- No alarms occurred on AGG-SAH-01 or LNK-SAH-01-A between 09:00 and 11:00. [T9]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected sites and their parents. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SAH-002: confirmed. Parameter changes applied at 10:23 match the KPI degradation onset at 10:15. [CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028, T10]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-A: rejected. No changes or alarms were found on the transport links and routers during the window. [T8, T9]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000193: Warning TEMP_HIGH on S-SAH-008 cleared well before the KPI degradation onset.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 configurations before future deployment.
- Perform check on external events for complete incident verification.
